title: Design: New Work Order window has no Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-19-after-new-work-order-unchanged.png, bt-p2-18-before-new-work-order.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click Create Work Order.
  2. Pick customer B in Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens with Customer, Asset, Asset Here?, View open work orders and Save.

Step 2:

  • No Bill To field appears; the window looks as in production.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R8: “New Work Order and New Part Sale show no Bill To.”
